{{Youmay|the in-universe operation|the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] [[Freedom Strike Seltos (adventure)|adventure]] from [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]}}
'''Freedom Strike Seltos''' was the codename for a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the government's formation. A group of operatives were sent to the planet to investigate whether or not the Seltos [[Magister of Trade]], [[Sinya Deboora]], was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. During the operation, the operatives discovered a secret Imperial base to the west of [[Sommin City]], discouraged an Imperial strike on the planet, and rescued six New Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] from pro-Imperial [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]].
